theme: An open day to clear the backlog.
greeting: A wide-open Monday, Dan — nothing on the calendar at all. With the girls at Jen's, it's a clean window to finally land the travel bookings that have been circling.

needsAttention.title: December break still undecided
needsAttention.detail: The family trip (Dec 13 – Jan 2, all four girls) was meant to be decided by Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year — pick domestic vs. international and lock a shortlist.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out. The task flags it as book-this-week, and it's been open since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland to St Pete drive lives in the Oct 5–18 off-week gap; after the 18th the window's gone. Set the dates and book the single hotel night.

needsAttention.title: Eugenia is waiting on a date
needsAttention.detail: She's back from Morocco Oct 31 and tossed it back to you — asking for a date or slot to talk, and whether you'll cross paths at ICGN in Toronto. Worth proposing a time before it drifts.

needsAttention.title: Early start at 9
needsAttention.detail: Dr Snowden at 9am tomorrow is the one fixed point after an open stretch — worth an earlier night.

flagged.title: Mom's care plan still unanswered
flagged.detail: Tampa Gardens hasn't replied on the updated plan-of-care form for your mother — you've followed up since August. Likely needs a phone nudge rather than another email.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and retail promos — Mattress Firm, Nextdoor, WeatherTech, Differentiated Design.

resolved.title: Ferry tickets came through
resolved.detail: The Maine State Ferry confirmation landed this morning and you forwarded it to Mike — the Vinalhaven leg is set.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn calls for chestnuts and winter squash at their peak — a dish built on what the season is bringing in.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: The calendar's completely empty — the morning is entirely yours.
Still clear through the afternoon; a real window for the overdue travel bookings.
A quiet close, with an early start set for tomorrow.
